simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to עֶרֶשׂ (H6210) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-f.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 10 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: עֶרֶשׂ (ʻeres) means a couch (properly, with a canopy) First listed occurrence: Amos 3 12.

definitions.full: H6210. eres עֶ֫רֶשׂ noun feminine Job 7:13 couch, divan ; — construct ׳ע Deut 3:11 +; absolute עָ֑רֶשׂ Amos 3:12 ; suffix עַרְשִׂי Job 7:13 +, etc.; plural suffix עַרְשׂוֺתָם Amos 6:4 ; — couch, divan , 3:12 ; 6:4 (|| מִטּוֺת ), + 2Sam 17:28 (read מִשְׁכָּב עַרְשׂת Klo Ne Marg. 18 HPS, compare ᵐ5 ); for lying at night Job 7:13 ; Psa 6:7 (|| מִטָּה ), Prov 7:16 , יְצוּעָ֑י עֶרֶשׂ Psa 132:3 the coach of (consisting in) my bed ; couch of sickness 41:4 ; marriage couch Song 1:16 ; perhaps transferred to sarcophagus, as last couch בַּרְזֶל עֶרֶשׂ עַרְשׂוֺ Deut 3:11 (see Dr). ערשׁ (√ of following; meaning unknown).
